title: In JetBrains IntelliJ IDEA before 2026.3, 2026.2.4 command execution via a hidden run control in the Markdown preview…
description: A vulnerability in JetBrains IntelliJ IDEA before versions 2026.3 and 2026.2.4 allows command execution via a hidden run control in the Markdown preview feature. The flaw permits an attacker to execute commands with limited privileges, requiring local access and user interaction. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 5.3.
